C1243.title: Grey Cash-Out Schemes Spread: 'Huabei and Baitiao Cash-Out' Ads Appear on Shared Bikes
C1243.summary: A 2018 investigation found that shared bikes in Shenzhen and other cities were plastered with small ads for 'Huabei and Baitiao cash-out' services. Intermediaries convert credit line into cash by having users purchase designated products via QR code and then buying back the goods at a discount, charging service fees as high as 8%-15%.
